messages.subject: svg displayed in Shiny page
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to display an SVG image within a Shiny page. It has to be SVG, because it's built using gridSVG, and has JavaScript animation code attached to it.

I've already looked through the code in this Shiny app:

https://github.com/timelyportfolio/shiny-grid-svg

but that's about a year old, and using a deprecated bit of Shiny, namely passing of functions to reactive elements.

My current code looks like this:

ui.R:
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
   
    headerPanel(title="CatchIT Map", windowTitle="CatchIT Map"),
   
    sidebarPanel(),
   
    mainPanel(
        uiOutput("map")
    )
))

server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
   
    output$map <- renderUI(svgHTML("interactiveMap"))
   
    interactiveMap <- reactive({
        make.map() })   
})

where make.map creates an SVG file using the gridSVG package, then outputs all the lines of the SVG file -- these are the final lines of make.map():

    svgoutput <- readLines("rotoiticatches.svg", n=-1)
    svgoutput

The global.R file contains make.map, and the function svgHTML:

svgHTML <- function(outputId)
{
    output <- tags$div(id=outputId, class="shiny-html-output", svg(width="300", height="200"))
}


Unfortunately, when I try to run this Shiny app, nothing happens -- I don't get any error messages, but also the SVG does not appear within the Shiny page.

I also tried using the htmlOutput function within ui.R instead of uiOutput, but that didn't seem to work either.

I've looked through the Shiny documentation for htmlOutput, but I still don't see how it's meant to work, and the example given is too basic to be of any use.

Any suggestions for how I should fix this would be gratefully received.

Thanks very much!
